beschreibung: A new spec reads the banner text, loads the reviews and then expects the banner to still say the same thing. The reviews take 80-340 ms while the banner rotates every 400 ms, so the rotation sometimes fires inside that window.
begruendung: test-only change: the new spec compares two reads of a banner that rotates every 400 ms across a step whose length is decided by the 80-340 ms review latency, so whether the rotation fires inside that window decides the outcome
